title: Show a screen or point at something (ui_show) arguments
description: Take the client to a screen, or point at one item on it (a target from a tool result, such as skin:pore, step:1 or shade:0). By default the app follows you until the client takes over by tapping; pass take_control=false to only leave a gentle pointer without moving the screen. Use it like a presenter: show the part you are talking about. Free.

screen.description: A screen id from the manifest.

target.description: A target, such as skin:acne or shade:1.
